description: Exact 64-bit integers (docs/int64.md): the int64 and uint64 modules, enabled per context, and json.parse's int64 and string modes.

cases.name: constructor rejects a number at 2^53, which may have rounded

expectError.messageContains: int64.lua:(1,0-18): bad argument #1 to 'int64' (number 9007199254740992 is outside the exact integer range of a number (+/-(2^53-1)); pass it as a decimal string)
int64.lua:(1,0-35): bad argument #1 to 'int64' ('9223372036854775808' is out of the int64 range)
int64.lua:(1,0-17): bad argument #1 to 'int64' (number 1.5 has no integer representation)
int64.lua:(1,0-24): bad argument #1 to 'uint64' (int64 value -1 is out of the uint64 range)

cases.name: arithmetic wraps at the limits
cases.source: return { tostring(int64.max + 1), tostring(int64.min - 1), tostring(-int64.min), tostring(uint64.max + 1), tostring(uint64(0) - 1) }

cases.name: division floors, modulo takes the divisor's sign, min / -1 wraps
division by zero is an error

expectError.messageContains: int64.lua:(1,0-19): attempt to perform integer division by zero

cases.name: mixing in a non-integral number is an error

expectError.messageContains: int64.lua:(1,0-21): number 1.5 has no integer representation

cases.name: comparison is exact across int64, uint64 and numbers
table keys by value
cases.source: local t = {} t[int64(5)] = 'a' t[int64('5')] = 'b' t[5] = 'c' local n = 0 for _ in pairs(t) do n = n + 1 end return { t[int64(5)], t[5], n }

cases.name: bitwise operations and shifts
cases.source: return { tostring(int64.band(0xFF, 0x0F)), tostring(int64.bor(1, 2, 4)), tostring(int64.bxor(int64.max, int64.min)), tostring(int64.bnot(0)), tostring(int64.shl(1, 63)), tostring(int64.shr(int64.min, 63)), tostring(int64.sar(int64.min, 63)) }

cases.name: tonumber is nil beyond 2^53 - 1
cases.source: local n, msg = int64.tonumber(int64('9007199254740992')) return { int64.tonumber(int64('9007199254740991')), n == nil, type(msg) }

expectError.messageContains: int64.lua:(1,0-36): bad argument #2 to 'format' (number expected, got userdata)

cases.name: returning an int64 to the host is an output error

expectError.messageContains: $: a userdata cannot be converted to JSON

cases.name: json.parse int64 mode: int64, uint64 above int64.max, numbers below 2^53
json.parse int64 mode rejects a literal beyond uint64

expectError.messageContains: int64.lua:(1,0-59): integer 18446744073709551616 does not fit in int64 or uint64

cases.name: json.parse string mode keeps the digits
json round trip in int64 mode
cases.source: local s = '[9223372036854775807,18446744073709551615]' return json.serialize(json.parse(s, false, 'int64')) == s
